about.title: A place to enjoy – moments to linger. A warm welcome!
about.p1: Whether for a quick bite, a fragrant coffee or a cozy get-together with friends – you are in the right place with us.
about.p2: Enjoy fresh snacks, homemade delicacies and lovingly prepared drinks in a relaxed atmosphere.
about.p3: Visit us and discover how simple enjoyment can be – uncomplicated, warm and always delicious.

discover.title: How about a little break?
discover.body: In our bistro you will find fresh dishes prepared with love. Leave the stress of the day behind – whether for a short pause or a cozy evening with family and friends, you are in the right place. Enjoy our tasty food in a relaxed and warm atmosphere. We look forward to welcoming you soon in our bistro!
discover.caption: Caravento Pizza & Restaurant – We warmly welcome you – enjoy good food and relaxed moments with us.

services.intro: Pickup, delivery, reservation, eat-in or table service. We are ready to serve you in all these ways.

menu.title: Culinary variety at Caravento – Hagenberg
menu.intro: Look forward to daily changing lunch dishes – a delicious mix of Austrian home cooking and Italian classics. Ideal for anyone who wants to eat well during their break!

contact.title: How can we help you?
contact.intro: We are happy to answer your questions, meet your needs or support you with any concerns. Do not hesitate to contact us so we can help.
